BiblicalUsage: Destruction here is the pit and the grave. The anointed of the LORD was taken in their pits, the breath of our nostrils, of whom we said, under his shadow we shall live among the heathen. But the psalm answers it: He sent His word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pit and the word that delivers belong together, and I hold that God's word still reaches into the pit.
